results.strategy_description:
One River’s Volatility Relative Value Strategy combines the investment team’s expertise in volatility trading into an absolute return, all weather strategy. The strategy is highly differentiated to other relative strategies because it embeds the following features:

-	Positive Convexity Structuring:  In developing the expertise to deliver years of consistent alpha generation across bespoke convexity mandates, the team has built a unique suite of tools and honed an approach that places convexity optimization and risk mitigation as central tenets of our investment philosophy. 
-	Macro Awareness:  The team considers traditional volatility market inputs while also taking into account macro risks and opportunities. 
-	Data Driven Process:  One River applies a specialized quantitative volatility infrastructure to support our fundamental portfolio managers using inputs such as valuation, microstructure data, structured product data, and dealer hedging activity. 
-	“Anti-RV”:  One River’s strategy seeks to identify when to participate in traditional RV trades and when to take the other side of these trades by predicting when market distortions are likely to erupt and/or persist.

results.name: Coast Capital Engaged Fund
results.management_company_description:
Coast Capital seeks to generate outsized risk-adjusted returns across market cycles by applying a differentiated investment philosophy and process. The Firm takes a concentrated, “Private Equity” approach to analyzing, and unlocking value, in publicly traded securities, primarily in European developed markets.

Coast Capital is a long-biased small and mid-cap value investor, which invests in a concentrated set of companies which we believe are leaders in growing and profitable industries generating high returns on capital, but trading at dislocated valuations due to structural or operational inefficacies. We then work to build positions of significant influence and partner with leading C-level executives to engage with companies for value creation.
results.strategy_description: Our investment process has been and remains simple and streamlined, yet vastly underemployed by investment managers across markets. We buy high quality businesses that are leaders in growing and profitable industries, which trade at material discounts to fair value, and then actively work towards long-term value creation in partnership with leading C-level executives. We focus on our highest quality ideas and run a concentrated portfolio of 8-12 investments. As a result, our returns have had little correlation to the markets in which we invest. We believe that this strategy, which we apply to an overlooked set of small and mid-cap companies in less efficient European public markets, will continue to help us generate long-term value for our investors.
results.region_exposure_description:
Western European public markets with greatest focus on the UK.

European public equity valuations stand near all-time-lows vs US markets, despite a very favorable economic backdrop that is for once positively decoupled from the US. Increasing fiscal stimulus, the rebirth of industry, falling interest rates, and the likelihood of a post-war economic recovery will, we believe, position Europe as a preferred destination of capital during this phase of heightened volatility in US equities. We also note that Europe benefits from a steady and predictable legal and regulatory framework, which are the founding pillars of stability that in turn begets capital flows. Accordingly, global equity funds have begun to shift allocations away from the US toward Europe at a record pace in the first quarter of 2025. We are emphatically not macro investors, but we believe these trends are set to continue.

results.strategy_description: PSquared Event Opportunity Master Fund operates a global event driven strategy with an emphasis on Europe & Asia. The strategy focusses on fundamental research and bottom up analysis with a view to identifying events in the short to medium term (3-9 months). PSquared has an investment philosophy which is based on (i) deep value opportunities, (ii) avoiding crowded situations, (iii) short to medium term catalysts and (iv) active management and monitoring of macro risks. The strategy is market neutral with an ability to deviate within a limited range on a beta adjusted basis dependent on market conditions. The portfolio construction is based on a concentrated number of investment position blocks, which we believe show a high correlation between the long and short legs in order to protect from significant market movements. The strategy seeks to generate returns purely through events crystallizing rather than a reliance on market direction or beta. The strategy will invest across the entire spectrum from soft to hard catalyst events, as well as given the principals’ backgrounds the strategy will look to express events throughout the entire capital structure to enhance the risk reward. However, only liquid/listed credit positions will be considered (bonds, convertibles, CDS etc). Position sizing will be determined by risk / reward as well as loss limits of every position block. Furthermore, there is a strong emphasis on underlying liquidity and the number of trading days it would take to unwind every position.

results.management_company_description:
Redwood was formed in 2000 to focus on investing in distressed and stressed credit. The Firm manages four strategies including a flagship hedge fund, distressed drawdown dislocation fund, a safer long-only strategy and an opportunistic private credit fund.

Redwood was founded by Jonathan Kolatch to focus on distressed credit investing. Prior to founding Redwood, Mr. Kolatch spent 17 years at Goldman, Sachs, where he retired as a partner in 1999. During that time, Mr. Kolatch headed the High Yield and Distressed Trading group from 1992 until 1996. He then started and managed the Credit Arbitrage Group, which focused on proprietary investing in high yield, distressed and emerging market opportunities.

There are 31 professionals at our firm. Our investment team is comprised of two portfolio managers, thirteen analysts and two traders. We believe in a tightly knit, focused and collaborative investment culture where our team members have a significant stake in the funds and where everyone is compensated based on net returns to investors. We offer investors four distinct ways to invest in opportunities across the credit markets:

1) Redwood Master Fund - Hedge Fund focused on distressed and stressed credit opportunities
2) Redwood Opportunities Fund - Long-only fund focused on bank debt and loans in the top part of a company's capital structure
3)Redwood Drawdown Fund - Drawdown fund focused on distressed and stressed opportunities in periods of dislocation (4-year investment period, 3-year harvest, Fund IV will accept commitments in Q1 2025)
4)Redwood Enhanced Income Fund - Opportunistic private credit fund investing in capital solutions and misunderstood private companies in the middle-market
results.strategy_description:
Our seventeen-person investment team works in a highly collaborative fashion to identify credit opportunities across the capital structure. We are contrarian by nature and strive for strong returns in all environments by judiciously adding risk when dislocations arise and de-risking as stress subsides. Our portfolio is long-biased with 30-40 core positions and three main areas of focus: 

(1) Distressed Situations 
(2) Stressed situations that don't involve restructurings
(3) Undervalued credit / new issues

We think about and manage risk in three categories:

(1) As part of our investment process  
• Waiting for attractive entry points
• Moving up capital structure when market risks are high
• Infrequent use of leverage

(2) As part of portfolio construction
• Maximum position size of 5% at cost
• 15% industry concentration limits
• Maximum risk of loss of 1.5% of any single position

(3) Hedging
• Individual stocks
• ETF’s or sector baskets
• CDS
• Currency

results.strategy_description:
Landseer’s European Smaller Companies Equity Long/Short strategy focuses on developed pan-European small caps. Landseer AM acquired the Chilton SC European strategy managed by Jamie Carter, who will join Landseer on 1st October 2023 as a Partner, and will continue to run his previous investment approach. The strategy will move from the Waystone platform to the IAM platform in September/October 2023. Jamie will fully utilize the Landseer infrastructure, execution, and shared research hub. Paul Graham (CEO and CCO) and Roger Guy (Chairman) will provide full, all-encompassing support.

The fundamental bottom-up research process focuses on developed European stocks with market caps between $200mn-$5bn (c. 20% in $5bn+). They seek to identify unrecognized under and overvalued companies with a strong focus on the following three pillars: 1. company management; 2. cashflow; and 3. catalysts. They aim to complete comprehensive due diligence through over 500 company meetings per year across all sectors, and with in-house modeling. The single stock alpha short book consists of overvalued / mispriced situations, supplemented by sector/indexes if required for balance sheet management. 

The net exposure is variable depending on the current and future opportunity set, ranging from -20% up to 40%, but is typically longer-biased. Gross exposure is managed to a maximum of 200%. The average holding period for longs & shorts is 12-24 months. The approach will have 50-70 positions in the book (on both the long and short side). 

The strategy will benefit from Landseer’s proprietary risk management framework which they have developed over many years. They aim to minimize overall market risk through a more active and variable management of the net/gross exposures and a generally stricter approach to factor and sector exposures. They will seek to limit drawdowns, while positioning for upside when appropriate.

results.management_company_description: Envestra Capital was founded in February 2023 by Ali Benzakour (ex-Millennium). Envestra is currently preparing for November 2023 launch of an equity long/short fund focusing on the energy transition thematic.
results.strategy_description:
Envestra is a market neutral long-short strategy which seeks to take advantage of asset mispricing linked to the energy transition thematic. The investment mandate is global with a European focus. The strategy aims to generate consistent alpha through both its long and short holdings with returns that are uncorrelated to equity markets. In order to achieve this, the manager combines his focus on fundamental stock analysis with top-down and thematic views to identify what we believe to be mispriced stocks, while adding further value through active trading and use of derivatives.

It is our view that the energy transition to net zero emissions is one of the largest and most complex economic and industrial transformations. The strategy seeks to focus on the sectors that are disrupted most by this transition: utilities, energy, renewables, infrastructure, transport and industrial sectors. We believe that the key to the investment philosophy is a holistic approach integrating industry and regulatory dynamics with bottom up fundamental stock research. The portfolio is comprised of a selection of 50-60 high conviction positions where the top 10 would typically represent 30-40% of GMV and is constructed with an aim to maximize alpha by reducing exposure to non-idiosyncratic risk factors.

results.name: Rushmont Capital
results.management_company_description:
Rushmont Capital is an equity long/short, market neutral, investment management firm based in New York. Chief Investment Officer, Campbell Chambers, brings a global investment management pedigree and a four-year track record of successfully managing client capital, most recently as the CEO and Portfolio Manager of Regal Funds Management USA. The investment process focuses on catalyst-driven investing, enhanced by fundamental analysis and systematic input, exploiting both soft and hard catalysts; remaining nimble, liquid and adverse to downside. The Fund invests in predominantly North American, and opportunistically in Australian, listed-only equities. The Fund focusses on and maintains a core overweight in the metals, mining and natural resources.

The portfolio is constructed of ~35 to 50 individual positions, ensuring a highly liquid portfolio, with typical gross exposure of 100% to 200% and beta adjusted net exposure of ±10%. The Chief Investment Officer will have ~100% of his net worth invested in Rushmont Day 1, and is launching with strong backing from pre-eminent advisors, seed investors and long-standing investment banking relationships.

Headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida with additional offices in Chicago, Dubai, Hong Kong, London, New York, and Singapore, our global reach aids our portfolio solutions and research efforts as we partner with portfolio management teams worldwide.** We pursue investment talent with a best-fit approach that allows flexibility between direct employment or external partnership. Lighthouse provides investment capabilities to a global clientele of institutional and high-net-worth investors on a product-specific and customized basis, across one or more of its four key investment verticals:
Equity: Primarily fundamental and relative value equities with sector and regional specialists;

Macro & Quantitative: Primarily discretionary macro, quantitative equities, and systematic trading;

Tactical & Opportunistic: Primarily spread-based strategies, including merger arbitrage, convertible arbitrage, capital markets, and other fixed income and credit strategies; and

Specialty Finance: Primarily private capital solutions focused on the reinsurance and consumer finance industries.

For investors, we seek to provide alternative portfolio solutions with a focus on alpha generation, diversification, and capital growth. Our institutional risk management aims to provide essential safeguards across an ever-changing global marketplace. Lighthouse offers managed account solutions to certain strategic, institutional clients through its platform services business. It provides comprehensive resources for managed account structuring and administration, operational infrastructure, and risk aggregation. North Rock Capital allocates capital to multiple PM Teams. North Rock is principally comprised of fundamental relative value equity strategies, with some quantitative equity strategies. The Fund is diversified by geography, sector/industry, and investment style at the aggregate Fund level. Underlying PM Teams tend to be sector/industry/regional specialists.

North Rock Capital allocates capital to a diversified set of relative value and long/short equity strategy-focused PM Teams. The North Rock portfolio strives to produce net returns based on strong alpha generation with low dependence on traditional market direction. North Rock seeks to generate risk-adjusted returns primarily through stock-specific (idiosyncratic) risk while limiting market beta and other market factors. The strategy is global in nature and exposure is managed to be diversified across sectors, geographies, and styles. The strategy invests in both fundamental and quantitative sub-strategies. North Rock deploys capital across multiple PM Teams that principally pursue sector-specific strategies. We continue to remain focused on fundamental stock selection as a key alpha driver, however, we also continuously evaluate strategies and approaches that can allow us to continue to evolve as the future opportunity set changes. In our view, the combination of diversification and continued refinement of our investment approach gives us the best opportunity to be successful in the future.
North Rock's investment philosophy centers around its sector-specialist model. North Rock believes that combining sector-specialist PM Teams focused on a defined universe of securities in a single hedge fund structure offers long-term sustainable sources of alpha. In short, North Rock's sector-specialist model allows the Fund to harness the experience of its PM Teams with the aim of achieving high-quality returns primarily driven by idiosyncratic risk and low dependence on market direction.

results.name: LOIM DOM Global Macro
results.management_company_description: Lombard Odier Investment Managers (LOIM) is the asset management entity of the over 220 year-old Lombard Odier Group. With a history of managing institutional mandates and funds for over 50 years, LOIM currently manages equity, fixed income, and alternative assets for clients across the globe. Lombard Odier Asset Management (USA) Corp ("LOAM USA" or the "Firm"), is the New York based Alternatives division of LOIM and central support location for the 1798 Alternatives strategies. We launched our first Hedge Fund in 2007, and currently manage assets across 8 investment teams focused on traditional (equity L/S) and specialized strategies (sustainable investing, convex trade structuring, UK small-cap, alternative risk premia, big data). We strive to have a collaborative investment culture and commitment to infrastructure, with over 75 individuals and an independent risk management team dedicated to the Alternatives business. We believe this equips our teams with the insights and focus necessary to generate alpha in today's environment.
results.strategy_description:
DOM Global Macro is a diversified absolute return strategy with embedded protection, that aims to deliver positive performance across a wide range of market scenarios. 
It is a daily liquidity fund combining proprietary systematic strategies and discretionary trading in a UCITs format, providing exposure to alternative, uncorrelated return sources and aims to diversify portfolios.
The fund takes long and short positions across the liquid multi-asset universe, aiming to deliver cash +7% p.a. with an annualized volatility range of 8% to 10% p.a.

results.name: Magnetar PRA Fund Ltd
results.management_company_description:
Founded in 2005, Magnetar Financial LLC (“Magnetar”) is a multi-strategy and multi-product alternative investment manager that seeks to achieve stable risk-adjusted returns by opportunistically employing a wide range of alternative credit & fixed income, fundamental, quantitative, and venture investment strategies. Currently run by two managing partners – Ross Laser and Dave Snyderman – Magnetar is registered with the SEC as an Investment Adviser. Headquartered in Evanston, Illinois, Magnetar and its affiliates employ a team of approximately 221 professionals as of December 31, 2025 and maintain three satellite offices in the US (New York, Menlo Park, Austin), and the UK (London).

Disclaimer: Assets Under Management (AUM) reflects approximate investor capital managed by Magnetar and its affiliated investment managers, on a discretionary and non-discretionary basis, including designated investments in side pockets and unfunded commitments (money committed to any fund managed by Magnetar and its affiliated investment managers as of the report date, but not yet transferred by the investors).
results.strategy_description:
The Passive Risk Arbitrage strategy was established under the premise that merger arbitrage investing offers excess returns that may be isolated based on certain deal characteristics, including geography, market capitalization, transaction type and deal type.

The Magnetar PRA Fund Ltd (the "Fund") will typically invest in the equity securities of companies that are targets of merger transactions in order to capture returns similar to those of a passively managed risk arbitrage index. Magnetar intends for the Fund's portfolio to be comprised of target company equities and to be reasonably diversified, subject to variance for many factors, including but not limited to, ramp-up periods, subscriptions and redemptions, position entry and exit conditions, market appreciation or depreciation and desired maximum position sizes.

The Fund's objective is to achieve attractive risk-adjusted returns which reflect the merger arbitrage risk premium.
results.region_exposure_description: The primary geographic focus of the Magnetar PRA Fund is North America, with additional exposure to Europe and Asia-Pacific.
